🟢 **Green Phase Complete:**
**Implementation**: Added birth rule to `/home/experimenter/experiments/runs/2026-07-25_23-41-37_game-of-life-example-mapping_v4-exact-subagents_opus-5-no-thinking/src/game-of-life.ts` — `nextGeneration` now returns surviving living cells plus dead neighbor cells with exactly 3 live neighbors.
**Result**: All tests now pass (7 passing, 4 todo)
**Approach**: Reused the existing `countLivingNeighbors` helper; the only new logic is enumerating candidate dead cells (the 8 neighbors of each living cell) and keeping those with exactly 3 live neighbors. No deduplication was added since no current test demands unique output, and no generalization beyond the birth rule the test requires.

Note for the Refactor phase: `bornCells` can emit the same coordinate multiple times (e.g. `[1,1]` appears three times for the test input) because each of the three living cells contributes it as a candidate. `toContainEqual` tolerates this, so it is left untouched for now.
